text:
maria.ng: Thinking about audit export UX and the underlying API shape. TL;DR: security/compliance wants diffs for routing/quota/rollout changes + streaming exports to S3/BigQuery. Need input on schema + where to store.

devon: +1 on diffs. We need exact field-level before/after and principal metadata (user id, service principal, IP, request_id).

samir: Agree. Also include a causal link to the rollout/PR if available (eg. release_id or job_id). Makes investigations faster.

leah: For the console view: show the diff inline with a small preview and a "view full change" that links to the raw event. Support filtering by resource type (routing_policy, quota, dashboard, rollout) and by user/email.

maria.ng: Questions: 1) Single audit_events store (append-only) vs push-to-warehouse export jobs? 2) API shape: queryable events endpoints (paged) or long-running export jobs?

michael: We should separate OLTP for live console queries (low-latency index) and batch exports for compliance. Live index could be ClickHouse/ES; export jobs can read from S3 parquet or from the event stream.

devon: Implementation debate: either we add an "events" table in telemetry-service (Postgres append-only) or we emit to the change-stream (Kafka) and have a consumer build the index. I prefer Kafka -> consumer -> ClickHouse, keeps telemetry decoupled.

samir: Kafka path is best for durability and replayability. But we need canonical event schema v1.0 asap. Suggested fields:
```
{ event_id, ts, org_id, principal_type, principal_id, principal_email, action, resource_type, resource_id, before, after, request_id, user_ip, client, trace_id, change_source }
```

leah: For exports: support formats CSV (for quick audits), NDJSON (for ingestion), and Parquet (for BigQuery). Exports should be scoped to time range + filters and be signed URLs + audit of export job itself.

maria.ng: Permissions: export must be limited to auditors/org-admins and create an accompanying export-audit-event (who kicked export, filters used, duration, result link).

michael: Performance note: building diffs on read is expensive. We should store the before/after snapshot in the event payload at write time (store small diffs for large objects).

devon: Agreed. Also we should cap export row size and emit a warning if events include large binary blobs.

samir: Ops concern: retention policy—compliance wants 7 years for some customers. Storage costs if we keep full before/after JSON for each change. Proposal: tiered retention: full payload 1y, metadata + pointers 7y. Provide tooling to rehydrate from object store if needed.

leah: UX: console timeline view for a resource with expandable rows, search within diffs, and a link "open in investigation" that spawns an incident view with correlated logs/traces.

maria.ng: API proposal (very rough):
```
GET /v1/audit/events?org=...&resource_type=routing_policy&from=ts&to=ts&format=ndjson
POST /v1/audit/exports { filters..., format: parquet/csv/ndjson, destination: s3|gcs|bigquery }
GET /v1/audit/exports/{job_id}  -> status, signed_url
```

michael: Add parameters: include_diff=true|false, max_rows, notify_email. Exports should be rate-limited and counted against org export quota.

devon: Internal API debate: should export be handled by telemetry service or a dedicated audit-export service? Pros for dedicated: simpler auth boundaries, separate scaling. Cons: duplication of schema & event replay. Leaning dedicated export service that subscribes to the canonical change-stream.

samir: If we go dedicated, require strict contract tests (schema registry) and nightly parity checks between index and exports.

leah: UI question: when someone clicks "who changed X" in the routing dashboard, should we show only authorized changes or include system/backfill changes? I vote show everything but flag system/backfill with tag.

maria.ng: Good call. Also need export-of-change-sets for legal requests with chain-of-custody info. Put an export-audit-event and sign the export manifest.

audit-bot: export-job 987 queued by maria.ng (filters: resource_type=routing_policy, from=2025-01-01, to=2025-03-01, format=parquet). ETA: ~6m.

michael: Edge-case: renames/moves of resources (IDs change). Need stable resource canonical id and log aliases.

devon: Follow-ups: 1) samir to draft schema RFC for audit_event v1.0 2) leah to mock console timeline UX 3) maria + michael to propose retention tiering + cost estimate. Can we sync tomorrow 10am?

maria.ng: SGTM. Sync 10am. Thanks everyone. :+1:
